detail.body: Removes LoCo-Zero++ support across the configuration, runtime, Python bindings, and CUDA kernels as part of #8489.  The deprecated  zeropp_loco_param  option is now explicitly rejected, while the standard ZeRO++ quantized communication path remains unchanged.
